title: Mosaic Focus digest
description: Authoritative contract for GET /focus/top10 and STORE_DIR/focus.json (SPEC.md §6). The LLM ranks; CODE assigns stable ids and validates before writing. Swift FocusItem must decode this shape.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the ranking run, with timezone offset.

headline.description: One editorial line summarising the current pulse.

id.description: Stable across refreshes for the same obligation. CODE-ASSIGNED: sha1(chat_jid + normalized title), 12 hex chars. The model must not invent ids.

chat_jid.description: Required key, nullable value. …@s.whatsapp.net enables Open in WhatsApp; groups with no deep link use null.

due.description: ISO-8601, explicit or inferred deadline. Omit (null) if unknown — never invent.

last_activity.description: ISO-8601 of the newest message that fed this item.
